semiconductor_relevance: High — IHP GmbH is a leading research institution specializing in silicon-germanium electronics, providing advanced technologies and development support relevant to semiconductor applications.
summary: IHP GmbH is a prominent research institution focused on silicon-germanium (SiGe) technology, offering high-performance SiGe BiCMOS technologies and integrated RF and silicon photonics modules. The institute supports research partners and customers with development services for specialized semiconductor processes and devices.
capabilities: Integrated RF and silicon photonics modules
Development support for specialized semiconductor processes
Pilot line manufacturing for high-frequency circuits

regional_presence.Germany: IHP is institutionally funded by the State of Brandenburg and the Federal Republic of Germany.
